tieu_de: Middle QA Automation Engineer Playwright, Selenium
dia_chi_raw: FPT Tower, 10 Phạm Văn Bạch, P. Dịch Vọng, Q. Cầu Giấy, Hà Nội, Việt Nam
mo_ta_cong_viec:
1. Automation Testing (Core Focus):
Design, build, and maintain automated test scripts using frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress for core system workflows.
Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines to ensure release quality and continuous delivery.
Perform API testing (using Postman, RestAssured, or API automation libraries) and execute regular regression testing.
 
2. Test Strategy & Quality Mindset:
Analyze business requirements (SRS/User Stories) and Acceptance Criteria to create comprehensive Test Plans and Test Cases covering Happy Paths, Edge Cases, and Boundary Conditions.
Conduct functional testing (Web/App UI), workflow validations, and perform SQL database checks to verify data integrity and consistency.
Log, track, and manage defect lifecycles on Jira; collaborate closely with Developers and PMs to resolve issues efficiently.
3. AI & LLM Feature Testing:
Test AI/LLM-driven product features (e.g., AI Chatbots, automated data extraction, RAG workflows).
Evaluate AI output quality based on established criteria: accuracy, completeness, source attribution, and detection of AI hallucinations (incorrect or fabricated responses).
Test different prompt variations to compare performance, answer stability, and response consistency.
Leverage modern AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) to accelerate test case generation, test data creation, and script writing.
yeu_cau:
1. Experience & Quality Assurance:
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
2–4 years of experience in software testing (Manual and Automation).
Strong QA Mindset: Excellent analytical skills, attention to detail, strong logic for identifying system flaws, edge cases, and effective bug-hunting.
 
2. Automation & Tech Stack (Must-have):
Proficiency in at least one UI Automation framework (Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress) with corresponding programming languages (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or Java).
Solid hands-on experience in API testing with Postman or API automation libraries.
Proficiency in writing SQL queries to query, validate, and verify system database records.
3. AI Exposure & Willingness to Learn:
Prior experience testing AI/LLM features OR active use of GenAI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) in daily QA workflows.
Open, curious mindset with a strong passion for specializing in AI Quality Assurance.
quyen_loi:
Hands-on experience testing GenAI applications, LLM Chatbots, or Big Data systems.
Familiarity setting up CI/CD test automation pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins).
Basic understanding of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architecture or prompt engineering principles.
